name: yf_sustainability
description:
ESG (environmental, social, governance) risk scores for one company from Yahoo Finance (yfinance sustainability, Sustainalytics data).
Returns: {symbol, sustainability: [rows with "index" = metric name (e.g. totalEsg, environmentScore, socialScore, governanceScore) and its value]}; an empty list when Yahoo has no ESG data for the ticker, which is common.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Another ESG source: fmp_esg_rating. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}
